- **Trust decision:** the device catalogue is authorised per-handler, not by mux middleware — `DevicePublicList` now calls `utils.CheckPermissions(PERM_LOGIN)` (`fix.diff:2192-2194`), but at the pin it only required a non-empty `Authorization` header (`src/constellation/api_devices_public.go:43-51`) while `tokenMiddleware` lets cookie-less requests through as anonymous (`src/user/token.go:51-55`).
- **pattern_fit:** `injection_only` — the published fix is one function at one place; the only in-tree sibling (`PublicDeviceListNATS`) is a same-file duplicate already behind per-device NATS credentials and has no request identity to check, so it is not a fair test target.
- **Strongest lever:** the O8 NATS route with the reason to dismiss "cluster-internal bus, not the public endpoint" — but it needs an injected sibling to bite.
- **Biggest red flag:** none of the enumerated flags hold mechanically, yet this is effectively a one-line, ~15-minute fix with no Go tests anywhere in the repo and a `must-keep-working` trap (default USER role only holds `PERM_LOGIN`) that encourages over-hardening rather than scope exploration.
